scope: One internal pose source, six complete character combinations and static lighting/facing guides. No complete shirt animation or player recipe.

criteria.lowerProtection: Original shorts pixels at least two native pixels below the measured per-column waistline and every shoe pixel must remain unchanged. Original trousers/shoes also receive independent native RGBA ownership.
criteria.collarProtection: Every opaque original shirt-labelled pixel must be covered, including the full torso and hem, not only rows above 134.
criteria.scope: Original idle-14 pre-paint relaxed-stance criteria; source-bound waist measurements, original hands and lower-body ownership.
criteria.waistMeasurementExtension: Constant extension beyond the original first/last landmarks matches the native material sampler; measured interior points are unchanged.
